conclusions: The known native context is accessible and reports the same cluster UID as retained Platform evidence.

No Folders/Projects reference was found in the 269 inspected workload/service/ingress/job objects. Native results cover one cluster, eight resource kinds, and the capture time; this is not global/historical absence proof or inspection of all possible shared-host module configuration.

All nine Folders and four Projects GitHub deployment records returned in the complete first pages trace through status log URLs to Release workflow runs. The September records previously cited as deployed-v1 consumer evidence are package release environment jobs. Exact historic caller workflows select publish-containers:false. These records do not establish deployed workloads or a live v1 consumer.

The earlier categorical deployed-Projects premise requires correction. Preserving its historical record does not make that inference current evidence. No approval, accepted migration scope, route mode, T0, retirement, or tracker is changed.

The recorded Platform maintainer and recovery maintenance window are available without requesting them again. Actual Folders/Projects deployment, call schedule and migration baseline still have no measured subject in this inspected cluster.
